question: Take genes lineage enriched in NK-cells alone and genes lineage enriched in B-cells alone as two cohorts. Give each size and, for each cohort, the mean nTPM in NK-cells, naive B-cells, memory B-cells and T-regs. Draw a heatmap of the ten highest-expressed genes of each cohort across all immune cell types on a log scale. Which members are CD markers? Test the two cohorts for overlap using all lineage enriched genes as the universe. Provide the table.

I cannot determine this from the available Human Protein Atlas tool endpoints without estimating.

The tools provide expression data **for a specified gene**, but do not provide:

| Required input/output | Available from provided tools? |
|---|---:|
| Complete list of genes classified as *lineage enriched in NK-cells alone* | No |
| Complete list of genes classified as *lineage enriched in B-cells alone* | No |
| Complete universe of all *lineage enriched* genes | No |
| Single-cell nTPM matrix for all immune-cell types for an arbitrary cohort | No |
| Cohort-level mean nTPM calculations or exportable immune-cell expression matrix | No |
| Enrichment-overlap test based on the lineage-enriched-gene universe | No |

Consequently, I cannot report the two cohort sizes, exact means in NK cells / naïve B cells / memory B cells / T-regs, the top 10 genes per cohort, a heatmap, CD-marker membership for those cohorts, or a valid overlap-test table. Producing any of these would require inferring the cohorts or the universe rather than basing them on tool results.
